subject: public-relations
intro: Public relations training leads straight into paid reputation work: media relations, crisis response and campaign management for brands, causes, governments and the people who lead them.

roles.title: Public Relations Specialists
roles.what: Promote or create an intended public image for individuals, groups or organisations, writing and selecting material for release to various communications media, with many specialising in social media.
roles.where: The research and planning unit's objectives-strategies-tactics model and the writing and channels unit — news releases, media kits, digital and social channels — are this job's daily tools, with the ethics unit's disclosure rules setting the guardrails.

roles.title: Public Relations Managers
roles.entry: Bachelor's degree plus years of experience
roles.what: Plan, direct and coordinate activities designed to create or maintain a favourable public image or raise issue awareness for an organisation or client, usually after years as a specialist.
roles.where: The crisis communication unit — lifecycle, holding statements, reputation repair — and the ethics and law unit's defamation and privacy basics are the judgement calls managers own, built on the media relations unit's pitch experience.

roles.title: Fundraisers
roles.what: Organise activities to raise funds or solicit donations for an organisation, designing and producing promotional materials and raising awareness of the organisation's work, goals and financial needs.
roles.where: The PR planning unit's formative research and evaluation, the writing unit's promotional materials, and the stakeholders and publics topic from the foundations unit are exactly how campaigns for donors are built and measured.

roles.title: Advertising and Promotions Managers
roles.entry: Bachelor's degree plus years of experience
roles.what: Plan and direct advertising policies and programs, producing collateral such as posters, contests, coupons and giveaways to build interest in a product or service for a department, an organisation or on an account basis.
roles.where: The PR-versus-advertising comparison in unit one, the owned-earned-shared-paid framework from media relations, and the measurement unit's objectives and metrics are the vocabulary of agencies these managers run.

roles.title: News Analysts, Reporters, and Journalists
roles.what: Report and analyse news stories for newspapers, broadcast and digital outlets, investigating events, verifying sources and filing reports that keep the public informed.
roles.where: The media relations unit's how-newsrooms-work topic is the inside view of this job, while the ethics unit's disclosure and transparency standards and the writing unit's news-release discipline teach both sides of the press relationship.
